validation.caveat: Indices-and-rules baseline, not a learned model. OSM landuse=construction is a sparse, incomplete weak label (precision is understated, recall is of mapped sites only). Injected patches reuse real spectra of the same scene but have no real spatial texture. Seasonal/crop and moisture change can mimic change; outputs are leads needing verification.

injected.note: not run for sand: no pixel-level ground truth; see visual QA and S1 corroboration

s1_corroboration.note: reported per tile, not used as a gate
